method: A project is included when its latitude/longitude falls inside one of the 52 compiled barangay polygons (point-in-polygon, not a bounding box). The containing barangay is recorded with it. note: 309 DPWH projects are located inside Labo. 309 carry a contract amount; 0 do not.
